name: eia
description: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA): energy statistics through the public Open Data API v2 (routes, data queries, facets, legacy series IDs), dnav data tables, Today in Energy articles, daily and weekly fuel prices, glossary and FAQs.

commands.name: list-api-datasets
commands.summary: List the top-level EIA Open Data API v2 dataset categories (coal, electricity, natural-gas, petroleum, ...).

commands.name: get-api-route
commands.summary: Get metadata for a top-level API v2 category (e.g. natural-gas, electricity): its child routes.

params.name: route
params.description: Single path segment category id from list-api-datasets, e.g. natural-gas, electricity, petroleum (multi-level paths containing '/' are not supported because the slash gets encoded)

commands.name: list-api-facet-values
commands.summary: List the allowed values (id and name) of one facet of a two-level API v2 dataset, e.g. all stateid codes for electricity/retail-sales.

params.name: category
params.description: Top-level category id, e.g. electricity

params.name: dataset
params.description: Leaf dataset id under the category (single segment), e.g. retail-sales

params.name: facet
params.description: Facet id from the route metadata, e.g. stateid, sectorid

commands.name: get-data-table
commands.summary: Read a dnav summary data table (e.g. U.S. or state natural gas prices): one row per series with the latest values and a link to its history.

params.name: program
params.description: dnav program directory

params.name: table
params.description: Table id. The area and frequency are encoded in it, e.g. NG_PRI_SUM_DCU_NUS_M (U.S., monthly), ng_pri_sum_dcu_STX_m (Texas, monthly), ng_pri_sum_dcu_STX_a (Texas, annual)

commands.name: get-series-history-table
commands.summary: Read the full-history table of a dnav series, one row per decade (e.g. Texas natural gas wellhead price, annual).

params.name: program
params.description: dnav program directory

params.name: series
params.description: History page id from get-data-table historyUrl (without ./hist/ and .htm), e.g. na1140_stx_3a, n3010tx3m

commands.name: list-recent-articles
commands.summary: List the latest Today in Energy articles with type, date, title, link and tags.

commands.name: get-article
commands.summary: Get the full text of a Today in Energy article by id.

params.name: id
params.description: Article id (detail.php?id=...)

commands.name: list-articles-by-tag
commands.summary: List all Today in Energy articles that carry a tag (e.g. electricity, natural gas, solar).

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag name as listed by list-article-tags, e.g. electricity, natural gas, liquid fuels

commands.name: list-article-tags
commands.summary: List every Today in Energy article tag.

commands.name: list-article-archive
commands.summary: List Today in Energy articles for one year from the archive, grouped by month in the page.

params.name: year
params.description: Year to list, e.g. 2025. Omit for the current year.

commands.name: get-daily-prices
commands.summary: Get Today in Energy daily prices: wholesale spot petroleum, natural gas and electricity, retail fuel, prompt-month futures and financial indicators.

commands.name: get-gasoline-diesel-prices
commands.summary: Get the weekly U.S., regional and state retail prices for regular gasoline and on-highway diesel (Gasoline and Diesel Fuel Update).

commands.name: list-glossary-terms
commands.summary: List EIA glossary terms and definitions for a fuel topic or a starting letter.

params.name: topic
params.description: Fuel topic or a single letter A-Z

commands.name: search-glossary
commands.summary: Search EIA glossary terms by keyword (form POST; read-only).

params.name: query
params.description: Term to search for, e.g. capacity factor

commands.verifyNote: write: dry-run preview only, not sent

commands.name: get-faq
commands.summary: Get an EIA FAQ answer and the related FAQs on the same topic.

params.name: id
params.description: FAQ id

params.name: t
params.description: FAQ topic id (from related FAQ links), e.g. 9 = Diesel

notes: API v2 commands use EIA's public key, the one the site's API browser uses. API values come back as strings. A data query returns at most 5000 rows; page with offset/length.

Discover datasets top-down: list-api-datasets → get-api-route (route='natural-gas', then 'natural-gas/pri', and so on) → list-api-facet-values → query-api-data. Route paths contain slashes, e.g. 'electricity/retail-sales'.
query-api-data exposes common facets (stateid, sectorid, series, duoarea, process, product). Use only the facets the route's metadata lists.

dnav table ids encode area and frequency, e.g. ng_pri_sum_dcu_{AREA}_{m|a} with AREA like NUS (U.S.) or STX (Texas). get-data-table's historyUrl gives the id for get-series-history-table. The 'values' and 'row' fields hold the whole row text.
Article urls are relative (detail.php?id=N). Pass N to get-article.
search-glossary is a POST search form. It was not sent during exploration, so its result layout is assumed to match list-glossary-terms.
Site search goes to search.usa.gov and is not covered. The RSS XML feeds were blocked during recording.

dropped.name: query-api-data
dropped.summary: Query data rows from a two-level API v2 dataset (e.g. electricity/retail-sales), with frequency, data columns, state/sector facets, date range, sort and offset paging (max 5000 rows per call).

params.name: category
params.description: Top-level category id from list-api-datasets, e.g. electricity

params.name: dataset
params.description: Leaf dataset id under the category, a single path segment, e.g. retail-sales or electric-power-operational-data

params.name: frequency
params.description: Frequency id from the route metadata, e.g. monthly, quarterly, annual

params.name: data
params.description: Data column to return, e.g. price, revenue, sales, customers. Without it only facet columns come back.

params.name: data2
params.description: Optional second data column, e.g. revenue

params.name: facet_stateid
params.description: Filter by the stateid facet (2-letter state or region code, e.g. TX, CA, US)

params.name: facet_sectorid
params.description: Filter by the sectorid facet (e.g. RES, COM, IND, TRA, OTH, ALL)

params.name: start
params.description: Start period in the frequency's format, e.g. 2024-01 (monthly), 2024 (annual), 2024-Q1 (quarterly)

params.name: end
params.description: End period in the frequency's format, e.g. 2026-07

params.name: sort_column
params.description: Column to sort by, e.g. period

params.name: sort_direction
params.description: Sort direction

params.name: offset
params.description: Row offset for paging

params.name: length
params.description: Rows to return (max 5000)
